propositions: Move Jira reconciler from src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ to rebar.reconciler subpackage; eliminate all by-path loaders (lazy_load, spec_from_file_location, sys.path.insert) from src/ and tests/
Delete test-side engine-root loader machinery (_engine_path.py, shadow bridge, autouse fixtures, root-convention tests) and rename tests/unit/rebar_reconciler to tests/unit/reconciler
Implement run_guarded_pass as single guarded core used by CLI, library, and MCP bridge_sync; library/MCP live pass now acquires lock and honors pause

Collapse three-hop bridge chain (subprocess → rebar bridge sync → python -m rebar_reconciler) to direct spawn (python -m rebar.reconciler) with process-group reaping via rebar._proc.reap_process_group
Delete three retired rollback toggles (REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE, REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE, REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP) and make fail-loud unconditional
Move reconciler scratch from bridge_state/ to .rebar/bridge/ with keep-last-5 snapshot retention and 30-day alert window
